CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
